proof_body:
by
  intro α _ ι _ c A hc hcov hA
  classical
  have hex : ∀ x : A, ∃ i, x.1 ∈ c i := fun x => hcov x.1 x.2
  choose g hg using hex
  have hinj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro x y hxy
    by_contra hne
    have hne' : x.1 ≠ y.1 := fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
    have hy : y.1 ∈ c (g x) := by
      rw [hxy]
      exact hg y
    have hxA : x.1 ∈ (A : Set α) := Finset.mem_coe.mpr x.2
    have hyA : y.1 ∈ (A : Set α) := Finset.mem_coe.mpr y.2
    rcases hc (g x) (hg x) hy hne' with h | h
    · exact hA hxA hyA hne' h
    · exact hA hyA hxA (Ne.symm hne') h
  have hle := Fintype.card_le_of_injective g hinj
  simpa using hle
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [PartialOrder α] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] (c : ι → Set α) (A : Finset α), (∀ i, IsChain (· ≤ ·) (c i)) → (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ i, x ∈ c i) → IsAntichain (· ≤ ·) (A : Set α) → A.card ≤ Fintype.card ι
